subject: Aligning initial discovery + technical intro with Helix Analytics
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Cheng <emma@helixanalytics.com>, soojin_lee@redwood.ai, marcus_lin@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 4 Jun 2026 15:20:00 -0700
Subject: Intro + discovery: propose two windows (60 min)

Hi Emma — great to be connected. Congrats on the rollout you mentioned in the notes. Im Aditya (AE for Redwood) and would love to coordinate an initial discovery + technical intro so our SE can understand latency/cost targets and your security/procurement needs.

Proposed windows (60 minutes):
- Tue Jun 9, 10:00-11:00 PT / 13:00-14:00 ET
- Wed Jun 10, 09:00-10:00 PT / 12:00-13:00 ET

Agenda (draft attached):
- 10 min intros & success criteria
- 25 min technical discovery (engineers + SE)
- 15 min deployment/security questions (security point of contact)
- 10 min next steps & procurement signal

Attachments: draft-agenda.pdf (light), quickstart link included below. Can you confirm which stakeholders from Helix will attend? Wed like: customer champion + engineering lead + a procurement/contact for contract questions + our SE (Marcus) + myself.

If those times dont work, share a couple of alternatives or book via my Calendly: https://calendly.com/aditya-redwood/30min

Thanks — Aditya

--
Aditya Rao
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
aditya@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0198

From: Emma Cheng <emma@helixanalytics.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>
Cc: soojin_lee@redwood.ai, marcus_lin@redwood.ai, Carlos Ruiz <carlos.ruiz@helixanalytics.com>, procurement@helixanalytics.com
Date: Thu, 4 Jun 2026 18:03:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Intro + discovery: propose two windows (60 min)

Thanks Aditya — excited to explore this. Quick notes from our side:
- Im the project champion (data platform). Ill bring Carlos (eng lead) and loop our security lead if we get into architecture details. Procurement is CCed.
- Were a bit tight on calendar next week; can we tighten to 45 minutes? Our preference is Thu Jun 10 11:30-12:15 EST (that maps to 08:30-09:15 PT).
- Before a deep technical session, could Marcus confirm whether a 45-min slot will let you cover the essentials (top-level architecture + a short demo + next-step checklist)?

Also, can you add any pre-reads? Id like our infra team to scan them beforehand.

—Emma
Emma Cheng
Senior Data Platform Manager | Helix Analytics
emma@helixanalytics.com | +1 (212) 555-4421

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Cheng <emma@helixanalytics.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>
Cc: soojin_lee@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 4 Jun 2026 19:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Intro + discovery: propose two windows (60 min)

Hi Emma — Marcus here (Solutions Engineer). 45 minutes is doable if we tighten the agenda: 10 min intros & goals, 20 min tech/discovery (focus on latency, model choice, and data flow), 10 min demo (hosted path + dedicated highlights), 5 min immediate next steps.

Pre-reads I recommend:
- Redwood quickstart (attached: redwood-quickstart-guide.pdf)
- Short checklist: network/firewall rules we typically ask for (Ill paste below).

Networking checklist (short):
- Outbound HTTPS (443) allowed to *.redwood.ai endpoints
- If you plan on private deployment: VPN or VPC peering details and a contact for SRE
- Any IP allowlist windows — let us know draft list

If were going to discuss SOC2/external audit artifacts, please let us know and well have our security contact on the invite.

I can hold Thu Jun 10 08:30-09:15 PT (your 11:30-12:15 EST). If procurement needs a separate 15-min PO touchpoint after the demo, were happy to slot that too.

- Marcus
Marcus Lin
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.ai

From: procurement@helixanalytics.com
To: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>, Emma Cheng <emma@helixanalytics.com>
Cc: soojin_lee@redwood.ai, marcus_lin@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 5 Jun 2026 09:02:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Intro + discovery: propose two windows (60 min)

Hello — procurement here. Were onboarding multiple vendor discussions next week and have limited overlap. We cannot confirm attendance on Thu Jun 10 (11:30 EST); can we move the technical session to the following week (w/c Jun 14)? If youd prefer to keep a single discovery/demo for all parties, our earliest availability is Tue Jun 15 after 14:00 EST.

Separately, please share the standard commercial terms and a one-page procurement checklist in advance so we can triage internally.

Thanks,
Procurement Team
procurement@helixanalytics.com

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Cheng <emma@helixanalytics.com>, procurement@helixanalytics.com
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 5 Jun 2026 13:12:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Intro + discovery: propose two windows (60 min)

Thanks everyone — Soojin (AE lead) here to consolidate. I hear three constraints: (1) Emma wants a 45-min focused discovery, (2) Marcus is okay with the tightened agenda, and (3) procurement needs the week of Jun 14.

Proposal to keep momentum:
Option A (single session, with procurement): Tue Jun 15, 15:00-15:45 ET / 12:00-12:45 PT (45 min)
Option B (split): Thu Jun 10, 11:30-12:15 ET — discovery + tech for Eng & SE; then Tue Jun 15, 15:00-15:15 ET quick procurement PO touchpoint (15 min)

Please reply with A or B. If A, Aditya will send a calendar invite with the meeting link and Marcus will reduce slides to the essentials. If B, Emma please confirm attendees for Thu.

Ive attached the one-pager procurement checklist and our standard commercial summary (internal doc links sent privately). Also sharing a HubSpot deal link so procurement can pull the current terms: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/deal/HLX-2026-0113

If you prefer, feel free to book a time directly on Adityas Calendly: https://calendly.com/aditya-redwood/30min

Best — Soojin

Enterprise Sales Lead | Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.ai | +1 (617) 555-0102
